description: This file implements the XRFCStore class, which manages configuration data related to RFC (Remote Function Call) features, including loading, caching, setting, and clearing configuration parameters, with thread synchronization and file I/O.

classes.name: XRFCStore
classes.description: A singleton class managing RFC-related configuration parameters, including loading from files, caching, and thread-safe updates.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of XRFCStore.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all stored RFC configuration data.

methods.name: reloadCache
methods.description: Reloads configuration data from files into cache.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a configuration parameter.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a configuration parameter.
